about_the_game: Level up in a real-time online world with other players, unlocking new skateboards and hoodies as you go. Get XP in over 10 skills, each opening up new abilities and ways to play the game. Every mob has its own loot table, so even the weakest foe can drop rare items for your PowDex. There’s also a chance that mob might drop an egg that hatches into a pal to follow you and help out.

short_description: Enter an MMORPG where skateboarding is tied directly to combat, gathering, and crafting. Level up elemental skills, chase rare drops, and build your legend as an early player. Play how you want with optional PvP, zero pay-to-win, and frequent updates shaped by the community.
